explanation: Store complete words in a set. Exact search checks membership; prefix search scans stored words and succeeds when any starts with the supplied prefix. An empty set has no matching prefix, even for the empty string.
timeComplexity: O(L) expected hashing work for insertion/exact search; O(U(P+1)) worst-case prefix-scan time for U words and prefix length P.
spaceComplexity: O(S+U) stored words/set entries; O(U) transient references for prefix search.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
